title: After the Yasuda Kinen: A Triumphant Bath

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I did it! I beat Ikuno! Hip, hip, mun!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: It would appear I still need to make some adjustments.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Tannhauser. It's been a pleasure running with you.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: What's wrong? You sound so stiff.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: …I was in peak condition for today's race.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: But even so, I lost. It would be a lie to say I'm not frustrated.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: But I can't allow myself to lose heart. Especially in front of someone as optimistic as you.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: I'm looking forward to running with you again.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Same here.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: By the way, there's somewhere I'd like to go on the way back. Would you care to join me?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Where's that?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: A bathhouse.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: From the heat of the bath to the pressure of the water, it is a multifaceted approach to relaxing your body.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: The better you are able to relax, the better you can sleep. That, in turn, improves your concentration and prevents potential future injuries.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Essentially, when you're tired, you need to recover. That cycle helps maintain better health going forward.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I-I see!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Now that we've decided, let's hurry up and go. Taking a bath for too long can have the opposite effect, so make sure not to stay in too long.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Haaah… It's so waaarm. I can feel it right down into my bones.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I bet I'm gonna sleep real well tonight… Mm-hmm…

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Hehe. That is the most important thing… But don't sleep in the bath, okay?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The two of them warm both their bodies and souls in the bath, reinvigorating themselves for their upcoming races.
